messages:
mira: Quick sync on compact eval list — proposing a single-column dense list with collapse chevrons. Main goals: keyboard-first, SR clarity, sane bulk-approve modal. Thoughts?

devin: Single column ftw. Keeps tab order predictable for screenreaders. Grid makes focus jumpy.

sam: Agree. Collapse metadata by default (model, run-id, timestamp). Row should show score, status label (OK/FL), and a diff summary. Chevron button must have aria-expanded and aria-controls.

leah: Bulk-approve UX: select rows -> confirm sheet. Do not render full provenance for 300 items. Show condensed rows + lazy-load per-item provenance on expand. Modal must trap focus and announce progress via aria-live ("Loaded 20 of 300").

mira: Good call. Copy: single action = "Approve", bulk = "Approve selected". Confirmation text: "Approving records reviewer and timestamp; this action is auditable." Add optional comment and "notify owners" toggle.

devin: Diff highlights: current method injects tags and causes reflow. Use overlay highlights with focusable tokens. Small CSS idea (no animation):
```
.diff-token { position: relative; }
.diff-token::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(255,235,59,0.14); pointer-events: none; }
```
Make tokens tabindex=0 and set data-change="added|removed" for SR.

sam: Also include a top-line diff summary in expanded area: "2 additions • 1 removal" so quick skim works.

leah: Accessibility nits: color-only badges are bad. Use text + icon. For pass green use #1f7a32 to meet contrast at 12px. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for expand animations.

mira: Keyboard shortcuts proposal: F to focus filters, A to toggle select-all (announce via aria-live), J/K move rows, Enter toggles expand. Document in handoff.

bot-lint: lint: suggested alt text for icons and aria attributes missing on chevrons in frame mirage-compact-v3.

devin: Implementation note: lazy provenance API should return small shapes (id, approvers[], notes[]) and support pagination. UI will progressively reveal details to avoid jank.

sam: QA checklist before merge: Up/Down, Home/End, Enter/Space toggles, Left/Right collapse, modal focus trap, aria-expanded present, live regions announce loads, reduced-motion respected.

mira: I'll update Figma and handoff docs with compact rows + collapsed metadata + overlay diff highlights + bulk-approve modal with lazy provenance and reduced-motion variants. React :thumbsup: to proceed or :eyes: for copy review.

leah: :eyes: please tag for modal copy check.

devin: :thumbsup:
